metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Crystal Lake
metas.description: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Furious
metas.description: A determined FBI agent delves into a female killer's history while partnering with a seasoned investigator to track her down.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Lucky
metas.description: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
metas.description: Berlin reunites his crew in Seville for an elaborate con targeting a powerful duke and his wife who've made the mistake of trying to blackmail him. Their plan involves faking the theft of a priceless painting as cover.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Lord of the Flies
metas.description: A plane crash strands a group of British boys on an unoccupied tropical island, where they gradually slide into anarchy as social conventions disappear and attempts at responsible rule divide them into warring factions.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor leads the superstitious residents of a cursed New England island.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · The Testaments
metas.description: This sequel to "The Handmaid's Tale" follows Agnes and Daisy, two teens in Gilead who must navigate an elite preparatory school where obedience is brutally enforced. Their bond becomes the catalyst that will transform their lives.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
metas.description: A certain atmosphere of horror is felt the week before the celebration of an unfortunate wedding.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Sankalp
metas.description: A saga of mentor vs. mentee: Kanhaiya Lal, the master kingmaker, devised a sure-shot UPSC strategy. Yet in every kingdom lurks a rebel-Aditya, defiant in the brood of powerful men. Who will break first?

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · How to Get to Heaven from Belfast
metas.description: Three lifelong friends reunite after the death of an old classmate turns a wake into a dark mystery. They embark on a thrilling adventure across Ireland, piecing together enigmatic truths amid complicated lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Ponies
metas.description: In 1970s Moscow, two secretaries at the American embassy become CIA operatives after their husbands are killed, uncovering a Cold War conspiracy behind the tragedy.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: Follows five friends in high school who receive a death warning from a mysterious wish-granting app. As they struggle to escape their fates, they uncover chilling truths that connect the app to the sudden death of a classmate.
